meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Searches BGPT scientific papers by topic or DOI and retrieves claim-level evidence extracted from full text, including experiments, reported statistics, scope, limitations, and provenance. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details beyond abstracts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按主题或 DOI 检索论文,抽取全文中的实验、统计与局限证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写文献综述或做证据归纳时要挖出论文里的实验细节
copy.tagline_en: Find experiments and statistics inside full-text papers by topic or DOI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need experimental details from papers while writing a literature review

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会通过已配置的 BGPT MCP 调用 search_papers 工具,按主题或 DOI 搜论文,返回从全文提取的结构化数据:方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分等 25+ 字段,而非仅有摘要。
howto.when: 需要做文献综述、证据合成,或查找摘要里没有的实验细节与定量结果时使用。前提是 agent 中已配置 BGPT MCP 服务器,该技能本身不开通 MCP 访问。

howto.what_en: Once the BGPT MCP server is configured, Claude calls its search_papers tool to find papers by topic or DOI and returns structured full-text data—methods, quantitative results, sample sizes, quality scores—not just abstracts.
howto.when_en: Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, or finding experimental details beyond abstracts. Requires the BGPT MCP server configured in the host; the skill itself doesn't enable MCP access.
